title: Limit Occurrences in Sorted Array
summary: Given a sorted integer array nums and an integer k, create an array where each distinct element appears at most k times, maintaining the original order.
statement: Given a sorted integer array nums and an integer k, create an array where each distinct element appears at most k times, maintaining the original order. If an element appears at least k times, it must appear exactly k times in the result.
constraints: nums is sorted and k is positive.
Keep each distinct value min(original frequency,k) times.
Return the retained sequence in its original order.
reference_solution:
def limit_sorted_occurrences(nums,k):
    return [value for i,value in enumerate(nums) if i<k or value!=nums[i-k]]
hints: Because nums is sorted, equal values form runs.
For index i>=k, retain nums[i] exactly when it differs from nums[i-k].
Earlier indices cannot exceed any frequency cap.
Looking k positions back detects whether k identical copies already occupy the output prefix.
